column4: If the programmer is supplying a Program Table of Exits, he must tell MCP where the
table is located. This is accomplished by placing the location of the first word of the
PTE in the refill field of index register 15, which is reserved for this purpose. (Obvi-
ously, then, the PTE must begin at a full-word address since the refill field of $15 is
18 bits in length.) Whenever the program reaches a phase where the mask that is in
effect permits program interrupts to be taken, the initial location of the PTE must be
in $15. Normally, then, one of the first instructions of a problem program would load
this location, or zero, into the refill field of $15. If this field is zero, MCP assumes
no PTE is provided. If the programmer wishes the use of special correction routines
for an interrupt that occurs while a special correction routine is in progress, it is his
